# GitHub Workflow Guide

This directory contains the collaboration and automation standards for DataLogicEngine.

## Contents

- `workflows/` — CI, security scans, deploy, release, and installer governance automation
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` — standardized bug and feature intake forms
- `pull_request_template.md` — required PR review checklist
- `CODEOWNERS` — ownership and review routing rules

## Maintainer expectations

- Keep templates aligned with current repo workflows and terminology.
- Update workflow references when scripts, paths, or required checks change.
- Prefer linking to source-of-truth root/docs files rather than duplicating long instructions here.
